subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the parenthesis.
stimulus: 0.5  10 = 5 Success in life depends on the proper (a) (utilize) of time. Those who waste their (b) (value) time in (c) (idle), reduce the time of their important work. (d) (Punctual) is another great virtue of human beings that (e) (rich) the (f) (man) life. If one takes lesson from the (g) (biography) of successful persons, one will learn that they never kept any work (h) (do) for the next day. (i) (Obvious), they were true to their word. So, they got a (j) (respect) position in the society.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both (a) utilization (b) valuable (c) idleness (d) Punctuality (e) enrich (f) human (g) biographies/auto- biographies (h) undone (i) Obviously (j) respectful
